title: Vintage & Exotics Laverda Jota 1000 Legend (Classic Heritage)
description: Representing Laverda's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Laverda Vintage & Exotics Laverda Jota 1000 Legend (Classic Heritage) is delivers authentic heritage styling paired with modern highway mile-munching comfort. A 1000cc powerplant pumps out 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
